title: Glossary Stage Gate Ledger
description: Written only by scripts/update_ledger.py: one row per stage, upserted by stage_id each time a stage passes or fails, re-verified at 15b_stage_gate_ledger. Never hand-edited — hashes are computed, not typed.

artifact.description: The gated artifact's filename, or a glob like path_glossary_bundle.*.json for fan-out stages (hash covers every match, sorted).

artifact_hash.description: sha256 of the current artifact bytes. Must be re-verified on read — a stale hash means the gate no longer applies to what's on disk.

verdict.description: Stage-gate verdicts are strictly binary, matching the sibling TOC pack's per-gate convention. PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_CHANGES exists only at the audit/consensus/freeze level, never at an individual stage gate.
